defs.def: to write or speak about sth/sb, especially without giving much information 提到；写到；说到noun

ex.s: The idea of sea level as a reference point for elevations has by now been around for so long as to go essentially unnoticed-we mention it without even considering what it means.
ex.t: 以海平面作为海拔参照点的想法如今已存在如此之久，以至于几乎被人忽视——我们提到它时甚至不去思考它的含义。
